channel.title: trez63 — one small app a day
channel.description: Every day ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Muse each build a single-page app from the same one-line prompt. Play them all.

item.title: Fold (Claude)
item.description: Pick one of 18 Platonic, Archimedean and prism solids and watch it unfold into a flat paper net: shuffle to grow a different net, tap a face to re-root it, set an edge length in millimetres and print a tabbed net to cut out and glue, with vertex, edge, face, dihedral-angle, paper-area and volume stats alongside.

item.title: NeuroHodgkin (Gemini)
item.description: A Hodgkin-Huxley neuron lab: set the stimulus current and the sodium and potassium conductances or pick a preset like a TTX block or a demyelinated axon, fire a patch-clamp pulse and watch the membrane voltage and gating variables on an oscilloscope while the spike propagates along a 40-compartment myelinated axon.

item.title: Spin Decide (Muse)
item.description: A decision wheel: add your options or pick a preset, weight them, then flick the wheel, tap the hub or press Space to spin it, with a raffle mode that removes each winner, ticking sound, a winner history and your own presets saved to a file.

item.title: Epicycle Sketch (Grok)
item.description: Draw a closed shape with the mouse (or load a random one) and watch it rebuilt from rotating circles: the app takes the discrete Fourier series of your path and animates the epicycles, with sliders for how many harmonics and how fast, and the same coefficients played back as a chord.

item.title: Solder (Claude)
item.description: A pocket circuit lab: drag wires, resistors, batteries, capacitors, switches, LEDs and lamps onto a grid and the board simulates it live, with node voltages and branch currents, flowing current dots, glowing LEDs, a scope for the selected part and presets like an RC timer and a voltage divider.

item.title: Ember (Muse)
item.description: A habit tracker: add habits with a weekly target, tap a day on each habit's calendar to mark it done, and watch today's progress bar, streaks, perfect days and total check-ins, with the whole thing saved to and reopened from a JSON file.

item.title: Inbetween (ChatGPT)
item.description: A cubic-bezier easing editor: drag the two handles or type their coordinates, set a duration, play your curve side by side with constant speed, scrub the playhead to inspect any moment, then copy the CSS transition declarations or save the study as a file.

item.title: TrussFEM (Gemini)
item.description: A 2D truss finite-element solver: pick a preset bridge, crane or roof span, drag its joints to reshape it and read the live axial stresses, deflection and safety factor as the direct-stiffness method re-solves, with sliders for load, cross-section and deflection magnification.

item.title: Quorum (Claude)
item.description: Split a password or recovery phrase into n shares so that any k of them rebuild it and fewer reveal nothing (Shamir's secret sharing over GF(256)), print the shares as cards, combine them again, and watch a curve explain why k-1 shares carry no information.

item.title: Interference Atelier (Grok)
item.description: Click to drop wave sources on a canvas and watch their ripples interfere in real time; drag them around, tune speed, wavelength and decay, randomise or pause, and save a composition as JSON.

item.title: Afterwords (ChatGPT)
item.description: Found poetry: paste a passage (or use the one provided), tap the words you want to keep in their original order, place line breaks, then lay the poem out as a printed page or a blackout of the source and export it as an SVG.

item.title: GeoTecton (Gemini)
item.description: A cross-section of crust and mantle you can tap to set off earthquakes: choose subduction, spreading ridge or continental collision, tune convergence rate, heat flux and fault friction, rupture the fault and read the P and S waves off the seismograph.

item.title: Typeflow (Muse)
item.description: A typing test: pick one of the built-in passages or paste your own, type it out and see words per minute, accuracy, errors and time, with your recent runs and best score kept in a list you can save and reopen.

item.title: Gordian (Claude)
item.description: Draw one closed loop that crosses itself, tap crossings to flip which strand is on top, and it computes the Alexander polynomial, determinant, writhe and tricolorability and names the knot from a table of prime knots.

item.title: Morphogen Studio (Grok)
item.description: A real-time Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulator: pick a preset or set the feed, kill and diffusion rates yourself, paint activator onto the canvas and watch spots, stripes and worms organise themselves.

item.title: Drawbag (ChatGPT)
item.description: Fill a bag with marked and plain tokens, choose a handful size and whether tokens go back, then draw handfuls or run a hundred trials and compare what turned up with the exact probability distribution.

item.title: Palette Lift (Muse)
item.description: Drop in a picture and it lifts out the eight colours that carry it, each with a hex code to tap and copy, plus a harmony built from the top colour; palettes can be named, kept and saved as JSON, all in the browser.

item.title: RayPrism (Gemini)
item.description: A 2D optical bench: drag prisms, mirrors and a laser emitter around, sweep their rotation and watch multi-wavelength rays refract, disperse by Cauchy's law and trap themselves in total internal reflection.

item.title: Trailnote (ChatGPT)
item.description: Import a GPX track (or explore the fictional example), move a cursor along the route to see distance and elevation at every point, and attach notes to places along the way; notebooks save and reopen as files.

item.title: Iris (Claude)
item.description: Paste a palette and see it through protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia. It measures every pair of colours under each one, names the pairs a reader cannot tell apart, and finds the smallest change that fixes them; lock the colours that must stay.

item.title: AeroFoil (Gemini)
item.description: A potential-flow wind tunnel. Pick a Joukowsky airfoil preset or set camber, thickness and speed, drag inside the tunnel to pitch the angle of attack, and watch the streamlines, surface pressure, lift coefficient and lift-to-drag ratio respond.

item.title: Timebridge (Muse)
item.description: Drag a 24-hour dial to propose a meeting time and see what that moment looks like in every city you add: who is at work, who is winding down, who is asleep. Jump to the hour with the best overlap and copy a summary.

item.title: Gradus (Claude)
item.description: First-species counterpoint after Fux. Pick a cantus firmus, let it compose a counterpoint that obeys the rules, or drag the notes yourself and watch every broken rule get named. Plays back and exports MIDI.

item.title: Pattern Lab (Grok)
item.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion on a canvas. Pick spots, stripes, worms or mitosis, nudge the feed and kill rates, and paint catalyst with the mouse to see the pattern grow around it.

item.title: Story Dice (Muse)
item.description: Roll five dice and get a story spark only that combination could produce. Lock the dice you like, roll the rest, and keep the sparks worth writing.

item.title: Trace (Claude)
item.description: Process mining from any event log. Paste a CSV of cases, activities and timestamps and it discovers the real process map, shows how often each path is taken and which hand-offs are the bottlenecks.

item.title: WaveForge (Gemini)
item.description: Fourier harmonic synthesis. Drag sixteen harmonic bars to sculpt a waveform, watch the oscilloscope and spectrum respond, pick sawtooth, square or organ presets and audition the tone.

item.title: Poise (ChatGPT)
item.description: Balance a hanging mobile. Choose a beam, set the weights of its two shapes, and slide the suspension notch until the turning effects match; the tilt preview shows which side pulls down, and the finished study exports as an SVG.

item.title: Crank (Claude)
item.description: A planar linkage laboratory. Place joints, pin some to the ground, connect them with rigid bars and make one bar the crank; every frame each free joint is solved as the intersection of two circles, so you can build a four-bar, a Chebyshev straight-line linkage, Hoeken's walker or a Jansen Strandbeest leg from the presets or from scratch, trace any joint's path over a revolution (coloured by speed), see in red where the mechanism binds, and save or reload the whole thing as JSON.

item.title: Symmetry Loom (Grok)
item.description: A mandala drawing pad. Every freehand stroke is mirrored and rotated into 2, 3, 6, 8 or 12-fold symmetry around the centre as you draw; pick a colour and brush size, toggle the mirror, undo, set the finished design pulsing, and save or reload all the strokes as JSON.

item.title: CipherLab (Gemini)
item.description: An Enigma machine and cryptanalysis bench. Type a message and it passes through a three-rotor Enigma M3 with reflector and plugboard (or a Vigenère or Caesar shift), with the rotor windows stepping as you go; a live letter-frequency chart against the English baseline, index of coincidence and Shannon entropy show how well the cipher hides the text, swap input and output to decrypt, and save or reload a key setup as JSON.

item.title: Labyrinth (Muse)
item.description: A maze you solve by hand. Each one is carved fresh by a recursive backtracker at 9×9, 13×13 or 19×19 and always has an exit; steer with swipes, arrow keys, WASD or the on-screen pad against a timer and move counter, leave a trail, ask for the hint path, and keep best times per size, with a maze saved or reloaded as JSON.

item.title: Trill (Claude)
item.description: A modem made of birdsong. Type a message and it plays as a short melody of 32 pure tones that another phone (or the same one) decodes from its microphone, with a live waterfall of what the decoder hears; Reed–Solomon coding repairs up to two wrong tones in every fifteen, the receiver locks onto slow, normal or fast sends on its own, a self-test routes a message through simulated room noise, and a message can be exported as a WAV to send by email or decoded back from a recording. Drafts and the inbox save as JSON.

item.title: CA Sonifier (Grok)
item.description: A cellular automaton you can hear. Paint cells on a 24×16 wrapping grid, pick Life, HighLife, Day & Night, Seeds or Life without Death, and press play: every birth that generation triggers a pentatonic note whose pitch depends on its row, voiced as sine, square, saw or triangle, and the grid and settings save as JSON.

item.title: Pinch (Muse)
item.description: A recipe scaler. Paste ingredients one per line, set how many the recipe serves and how many you are feeding (or tap half, double, triple), and every quantity rescales to friendly fractions with units and foods pluralised correctly, ranges and mixed numbers included; copy or download the result and save the recipe as JSON.

item.title: Selvedge (ChatGPT)
item.description: A four-shaft weaving studio. Tap a crossing in the rendered cloth, thread its warp end onto a shaft and choose which shafts lift on each pick, and watch the drawdown, threading and liftplan notation update along with the longest warp and weft floats; start from twill, basket, plain or broken twill, pick yarn colours, undo, save the draft as JSON or export the swatch as SVG.

item.title: AWS Diagram Studio (Claude)
item.description: An AWS architecture diagram editor. Drag services from a searchable palette of embedded AWS Architecture Icons (or upload your own), nest them in cloud, account, region, AZ, VPC, subnet and security-group boundaries, draw labelled elbow or straight connectors, add notes and extra pages, then step through the flow in Present mode with animated traffic dots; save as JSON, copy a share link, or export PNG, vector PDF, SVG or an animated GIF. Unlike the others, this one took several rounds of prompting rather than a single pass, and the PDF and GIF exporters are pulled from a CDN on demand instead of being inlined.

item.title: LinguistTree (Gemini)
item.description: A sentence parser you can watch work. Type an English sentence and it tags each word's part of speech, then draws it either as a constituency tree (S splitting into noun and verb phrases) or as dependency arcs from each head to its modifiers, with token count, tree depth and the root verb shown up top. Light and dark themes; a parse saves and reloads as JSON.

item.title: LogiGate (Gemini)
item.description: A digital logic workbench. Spawn switches and AND, OR, XOR, NAND and NOT gates, wire them by tapping an output pin then an input pin, drag them around the schematic and flip the switches to see every wire and output light up high or low; a half-adder demo is built in, a pulse clock toggles the inputs on a timer, and a circuit saves or reloads as JSON.

item.title: MazeForge (Gemini)
item.description: A maze generator with an animated solver. It carves a random maze by recursive backtracking at the grid size you choose, then A*, Dijkstra or breadth-first search explores it in real time, colouring the frontier as it goes and the shortest path when it arrives, with explored-node and step counts to compare the three. Tap or drag to add and remove walls; a maze saves and reloads as JSON.

item.title: MorphoField (Gemini)
item.description: A Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion dish. Two virtual chemicals feed and kill each other on a 128×128 field and self-organise into coral labyrinths, dividing cells, leopard spots or soliton waves depending on the feed and kill rates you set; tap or drag to inject more reagent, pick from presets and colour palettes, pause, re-seed, and save or reload a state as JSON.

item.title: OptiPath (Gemini)
item.description: A geometric optics bench. A laser fires across the canvas and bends by Snell's law through draggable glass blocks of adjustable refractive index, reflecting totally when it meets an interface past the critical angle; turn the emitter angle, change the wavelength colour, add prisms and lenses, and save or reload a setup as JSON.

item.title: Belfry (ChatGPT)
item.description: A change-ringing studio for six synthesised bells. Tap a bell to hear it, play a score row by row at a chosen strikes-per-minute, follow one bell’s path through the diagram, edit which neighbouring positions swap on each row or build your own method and return it to rounds, choose a bronze or glass voice, and save the score as JSON or export the performance as a WAV.

item.title: Drift (Muse)
item.description: An ambient soundscape mixer. Rain, ocean, wind, fire and birdsong are synthesised live from filtered noise and scheduled chirps and crackles, with no recordings; blend them with sliders, start from presets like Rainy Night or Forest Dawn, set a sleep timer, and save or open a mix as JSON.

item.title: Dropzone (Muse)
item.description: A Galton board. Tap along the top to drop a ball, or release ten, a hundred or a steady rain, and watch them bounce through 5 to 12 rows of pegs into bins while a histogram fills in against the ideal binomial curve; live stats show the count, mean, spread and bell match, and results save and reopen as JSON.

item.title: Lathe (Claude)
item.description: A pottery wheel in one file. The pot is a solid of revolution rendered in software on a 2D canvas; drag on the wall to pull it out or push it in, smooth out lumps, set brush width and height, start from vase, bowl, bottle, cup or plate presets, pick glazes and camera tilt, then save the pot as JSON or export a watertight OBJ with real wall thickness for 3D printing.

item.title: Passphrase Forge (Muse)
item.description: A password and passphrase generator. Forge a memorable multi-word passphrase or a random character password from the browser’s secure random source, tune words, separators, capitals, length and character sets, and see the entropy in bits with estimated offline and online crack times; recent results are kept for copying and settings save as JSON.

item.title: Swiftread (Muse)
item.description: An RSVP speed reader. Paste any text and press play to see it one word (or two or three) at a time with the focal letter highlighted so your eyes stay still; set the words per minute live, skip or jump along the progress bar, and save or open your text and position as JSON.

item.title: Moonpost (ChatGPT)
item.description: Lunar parcel delivery. Choose a route, set angle and speed, launch the parcel across low-gravity terrain and land on the striped pad to collect its stamp; thread the orange ring for a gold postmark.

item.title: Ebru (Claude)
item.description: A paper-marbling bath. Tap to float ink drops that push the earlier ones aside, then drag a rake, comb, wave or swirl through them; every gesture is an exact closed-form deformation, so pictures replay perfectly from the saved gesture list, and you can start from stone, gelgit, nonpareil, bouquet, peacock or vortex presets, switch palettes and paper, undo, and export a 2000-px PNG.
